prompt: Scores on a standardized test have mean $500$ and standard deviation $100$. Jordan scored $650$. What is Jordan's $z$-score?
hint: A $z$-score counts how many standard deviations a value sits above (or below) the mean.

hints.text: A $z$-score counts how many standard deviations a value sits above (or below) the mean.

explanation: Jordan is $650 - 500 = 150$ points above the mean.
One standard deviation is $100$ points, so $150$ points is $1.5$ standard deviations.

alternativeExplanations.title: Count in SD steps
steps: One SD above the mean is $600$; two SDs above is $700$.
$650$ is exactly halfway between those, so it is 1.5 SDs above the mean.
